name: Demo
description: Plays an authored script of real actions in Rack while a synthetic pointer, a gesture badge and a narrated card explain what is happening. An authoring tool, not a musical module.
author: Chris Graham

modules.name: Demo
modules.description: Opens the demo transport, which plays a scripted demonstration over the top of the rack.

modules.name: Demo Recorder
modules.description: Records Rack's own window to a video while you work, and writes down what happened and when, so captions can be placed afterwards.
